title: Recursive GCD and ratios
summary: Functions, recursion and the call stack (watch it grow in Visualize).
hints: Two lines are enough: `if (b == 0) return a;` then `return gcd(b, a % b);`
Press Visualize with a small input hard-coded in main (the visualiser has no stdin) to watch one stack frame per recursive call appear and then unwind.
